brief: @buildthis.bisks.net build a browser-based rss reader, also usable as a standalone SPA. Users can CRUD feeds, as well as import/export feed sets. Make it extremely clown themed. Over-the-top clown concepts, but still 100% functional RSS reader.
note: built honkfeed 🤡 -- a real rss reader (crud feeds, opml/json import-export, sanitized reading pane) wearing an extremely clown big-top theme, for dulanyw.bsky.social
